title: Oakridge Family Campground

services.name: Cabin 4
services.desc: Above rates are for one family, which consists of two adults and their unmarried children under 18 years of age, or up to the number of people that the cabin sleeps. Deposit required upon booking is two night's stay. For holiday weekends, a deposit of the full stay is required. Minimum two night stay in any rental unit. Minimum three night stay on holiday weekends. PLEASE NOTE! We are a family-style campground, open to families and couples with set quiet hours and controlled access for security. We do not tolerate excessive noise, excessive alcohol consumption, or offensive language. Anyone found to be causing any of the above during their stay, or who is generally disruptive to the family
